title: At the Doctor
description: A girl feels ill and visits the doctor.
instructions: Read the text about a visit to the doctor, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: On Monday, Emma felt ill. She had a bad cough and a sore throat. She did not go to school.
Her mum took her to the doctor. The doctor's name was Dr Khan. He looked in Emma's mouth and listened to her chest.
Dr Khan gave Emma some medicine. He said, 'Drink lots of water and rest in bed for three days.' On Thursday, Emma felt better.

For three days, Emma stayed in bed. Her mum made her hot soup with chicken and carrots. Emma drank lots of water and orange juice. She slept a lot, too. In the evening, her dad came home and read her a story.

Emma was bored in bed. She wanted to play with her friends. She read two books and watched some cartoons. Her grandma called her on the phone every evening. Her friend Ben sent her a funny card. It had a picture of a cat in bed.
Her cough was quiet now and her throat did not hurt. She was hungry again, so she ate a big breakfast of eggs and bread. In the afternoon, she played with her little brother in the garden.

On Friday, Emma went back to school. Her teacher, Mrs Hill, said, 'Welcome back, Emma!' Her friends were happy to see her. Emma said thank you to Ben for the card. She was very happy to be at school again.
